process_definition.description: Twelve-stage analytical lifecycle requested for Phase 5. Reuses mapped source evidence and case-local qualified assumptions; this is not an official Simpson policy or authorization instrument. Physical and commercial event waits remain independently pending.

stages.description: Retrieve the existing mapped OEM complaint. This does not create or alter an authoritative complaint record.
stages.name: OEM complaint initiation

reported_symptom.fallback_value: OEM symptom evidence is unavailable; obtain the actual complaint report.

stages.description: Ticket registration and validation — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Ticket registration and validation

registration_analysis.fallback_value: Ticket registration cannot be verified from available source evidence.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Existing mapped ticket observed; analytical validation does not create or modify a source ticket.

stages.description: Warranty assessment — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Warranty assessment

fallback_value.statement: Authoritative warranty policy is unavailable. Case-local analytical continuation grants no eligibility, payment or replacement authorization.

stages.description: Investigation initiation — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Investigation initiation

investigation_plan.fallback_value: Proposed investigation only; no engineer assignment or contact is confirmed.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Review reported complaint observations and obtain independent field evidence; investigation activities are proposed only.

stages.description: Joint inspection scheduling — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Joint inspection scheduling

scheduling_proposal.fallback_value: No appointment is confirmed. Obtain actual engineer, account, recipient, calendar, slot and action authorization before sending or booking.

stages.description: Field inspection and diagnosis — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Field inspection and diagnosis

reported_diagnosis.fallback_value: No inspection evidence is available. Diagnostic hypothesis only; a physical inspection and root cause are unverified.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Available complaint observations justify field investigation; root cause remains unconfirmed.

stages.description: Technical disposition — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Technical disposition

technical_proposal.fallback_value: Insufficient evidence for a confirmed technical disposition; analytical proposal only.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Review the reported diagnosis and chosen analytical route; neither repair nor replacement is authorized by this proposal.

stages.description: Commercial and authorization decision — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Commercial and authorization decision

commercial_proposal.fallback_value: Commercial review remains pending. No commercial authorization is granted.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Submit the analytical disposition for actual commercial authorization; this recommendation grants no authority.

stages.description: Replacement and logistics — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: Replacement and logistics

replacement_proposal.fallback_value: Replacement and logistics proposal only. No authorization, dispatch, shipment, receipt, installation or source update is confirmed.

stages.description: QA investigation — analytical execution; real-world activities require their own evidence.
stages.name: QA investigation

qa_analysis.fallback_value: QA evidence is unavailable. No physical test, confirmed root cause or QA approval is claimed.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Use the reported diagnosis to propose QA examination; laboratory findings and root cause remain unconfirmed.

engineering_proposal.fallback_value: Corrective engineering proposal only. No approved change, incorporation or implementation is confirmed.

inference.explanation: Configured provisional interpretation of the cited observations; no physical completion or authority is inferred.
inference.value: Review the available diagnosis and investigate a corrective engineering proposal; no change is implemented by this analysis.
